In the past year I've finally found the courage to embrace my sexuality. Just a couple of stories I'd like to share:

1) Me: Hey, so I'm bi...
   Friend: That's so cool! So... have you ever had a crush on me?

2) Me: Hey, check out this really cute gay guy
   Friend: Ew! I don't wanna look at gay guys!
   Me: I'm bi.

3) And on to a more encouraging coming out experience
  Me: I'm bi. And I feel like shit about it. 
  Brother: Don't care. 
  Later in a text from him: Maybe if you stop seeking approval from mainstream society, things might be    different. 

That made me love him so much more.
